short_description: Large plump pyramidal acid-secreting cell of the gastric glands: deeply invaginated intracellular secretory canaliculi lined with microvilli, an extreme density of mitochondria (about a third of cell volume) powering H+/K+-ATPase proton pumps that acidify the stomach to pH 1; also the source of intrinsic factor for vitamin B12 uptake.
color_legend: cell body warm eosinophilic pink (H&E teaching convention), secretory canaliculus pale luminous ice-blue/teal branching channels fringed with microvilli, mitochondria warm orange-red ovals with inner cristae, nucleus soft blue-violet sphere at centre, tubulovesicles small pale yellow-green tubules/vesicles clustered near the canaliculus membrane, gland lumen soft neutral space above the apex, basal lamina thin cream line under the base
